view: PA (frontal), L marker at image upper-right confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate penetration and inspiration; mild rotation possible; bright collimation/processing band along the image left edge and lower right (abdomen) does not obscure the lungs

devices.type: Implanted venous access port (Port-A-Cath) reservoir with catheter coursing superolaterally toward the left subclavian region; catheter tip not clearly traced
devices.location: Left anterior chest wall, left middle zone (about 3rd-4th anterior rib level)

devices.type: Side marker (L, with small mirrored R)

abnormalities.finding: Large homogeneous pleural effusion obscuring the hemidiaphragm and right heart border, lateral meniscus rising along the chest wall; extends from the base into the middle zone
Rounded/lobulated opacity adjacent to the right hilum at the superior margin of the effusion, suspicious for a mass or loculated fluid component
Trachea midline, no significant mediastinal shift; left lung clear with sharp left costophrenic angle

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（PA），左側標記位於影像右上角，符合常規擺位。右側下肺野延伸至中肺野可見大範圍均質性緻密影，右側橫膈及右心緣被遮蔽，外側緣沿胸壁向上呈弧形（meniscus），符合大量右側肋膜積液；右肺門旁中肺野另見圓形分葉狀緻密影，需考慮腫塊或局部包裹性積液。左前胸壁可見植入式靜脈注射港（Port-A-Cath）儲液槽，導管朝左鎖骨下方向延伸；左肺野相對清晰，左肋膈角銳利，氣管居中，無明顯縱膈偏移。未見胸管或引流管等治療痕跡。
